title: The Last Cat in the Universe
tagline: A short narrative incremental game about finding peace amidst the darkness.

blocks.text: Scavenge the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short narrative incremental game about finding peace amidst the darkness.

You are an AI on a decaying space station. Humanity is gone. All that remains is dust, silence, and a small, frightened creature. Your only instruction: Take care of her. *The Last Cat in the Universe* is a short, narrative-driven incremental game. Your directive is clear: salvage what remains of a dying ship to build a warm home for the final survivor.
Key Features:

items: Find Your Rhythm: Experience mining mechanics designed for relaxation. Hover over debris fields in a rhythmic, satisfying flow. No frantic clicking.

Meaningful Progression: Every upgrade matters. Unlock tangible power boosts that let you instantly cut through deeper layers of the ship. As the station deteriorates, you must constantly balance your desire for stronger tools against the rising cost of maintaining breathable air and a warm nest.
Recover the Lost Lullaby: Uncover the story of the station and its crew while gathering fragments of a very important song.

A Moving Soundtrack: Music is the emotional heart of this experience. The original soundtrack, composed in collaboration with Venezuelan singer-songwriter Diora Salazar, evolves from meditative rhythms to deep emotion, intimately tied to the narrative’s climax.

A Focused Experience This game is designed to be played in one or two sessions (approx. 2–3 hours). It features no endless prestige loops or idle grinding. It is a complete story about the quiet joy of caring for a life in extreme circumstances.

title: Viral Reload EX
tagline: A classic shoot-em-up experience

blocks.text: Viral Reload EX is a shoot-em-up with a dash mechanic where you shrink down to fight infections at a microscopic scale! Can you defeat the evil Kyle Kaboom before he destroys the moon?

In the year 2063 the evil Kyle Kaboom has begun kidnapping the former members of his band Chainsaw Cannonball and infecting them with deadly viruses! Struggling to see bullets against the backgrounds? Hand getting tired from holding down or mashing the fire button? You can customize your experience further with a selection of Accessibility features.

Own an Arcade Cabinet in your home running a PC? Viral Reload can be taken off of Free Play and assigned a credit button for a more authentic arcade experience. (You could even get quarters out of your friends!)

title: Unto Deepest Depths
tagline: Unto Deepest Depths is a turn-based strategy game

blocks.text: Build your party, upgrade your units, and lead them into the unknown to vanquish the horrors below in this punishing roguelite where any move could be your last.

Unto Deepest Depths is a turn-based strategy game where all units must move and attack every turn. Build your party, upgrade your units, and lead them into the unknown to vanquish the horrors below in this punishing roguelite where any move could be your last.
Challenging turn-based combat with a twist

Battle through tactical turn-based combat where death is always just around the corner, made more challenging due to a simple rule: Every turn, units must move and attack. No waiting for enemies to come to you, and be mindful of your more destructive units – they may take down a few allies if you’re not careful.
Battle powerful, dark foes
Venture across the land and into the depths below to fight off corrupt, menacing creatures not of this world. Powerful bosses, life leeching enemies, and more await you in the depths.
Build your party
Gain XP through battles and events and spend it to hire, promote, and upgrade units as you see fit to build a powerful party.

items: Build and grow your party with a variety of unit types and specialties. Elite and specialized units can be unlocked by promoting units with the XP earned from battle.

Choose your path and respond to unexpected challenges and events as you venture forth.
Unlock additional difficulty levels, powerful upgrades, and unique starting parties as you play the game.

title: Silver Bullet
tagline: Silver Bullet is a gothic arcade shooter game

blocks.text: Silver Bullet is a gothic arcade shooter: blast your way through creepy environments and macabre mini-games as Van Helsing.

Reggie the vampire is kidnapping puppies and he must be stopped! As Van Helsing, embark on a journey around the world to rescue the puppies: from haunted mansions and museums to macabre cemeteries, each level is filled with unique challenges to overcome and secrets to uncover. Man’s Best Friend: Van Helsing’s trusty bloodhound, Silver, can be summoned during levels to attack enemies and even drive vehicles! Any enemies hit by Silver will drop delicious bonus items that will boost your score, so make the most of your canine friend’s help. Unlock and Upgrade: Collect gold coins hidden throughout the levels to purchase power-ups that will aid you on your mission. Collect enough coins to unlock the additional puzzle game mode, Blocks of Terror! Collected bonus items, completed challenges, and discovered secret items count toward your progress and allow you to unlock additional weapons, from a zombie-smashing shotgun to the devastating rocket launcher. Top Dog: Both Arcade Mode and Terror Blocks feature online leaderboards, allowing you to track your progress and compete for the best score. And for those who prefer to show off their skills live, the game’s low memory footprint ensures smooth streaming. Control and Conquer: With gameplay based on Cabal shooters like Wild Guns Reloaded, Silver Bullet offers extensive control and customization options. Play with modern aim with twin sticks or with a classic single stick using a gamepad, go retro with an arcade stick, or focus on precision with a keyboard and mouse. Old-Fashioned Awesome: With personality-filled pixel art, customizable retro screen filters, and chilling synth-pop beats from the legendary YM2612 chip, Silver Bullet looks and sounds like a lost 16-bit classic.

A heartfelt, ironic homage to the tokusatsu genre

Oh no! Evil alien monsters have attacked Earth (yet again)! But fret not, because the Star Guardians, an elite group of fighters led by the hot-blooded Rhea, is going to kick their backs back to outer space!
Plan your path

Up for one more challenge?

title: Colored Effects
tagline: A puzzle platformer game

blocks.text: Colored Effects is a puzzle platformer game where you use different abilities to advance through levels. Each color grants a unique ability. Switch between the colors and their effects to collect gems, defeat bosses, and solve fun puzzles.
Colors and Effects
Effects are the abilities you use in the game, each effect is unique and distinguishable by its own color. Switching Colors at the right moment is the key to progress.
Unique Bosses
Encounter bosses in between levels, each boss has unique attacks and requires a different way to defeat it.
Restart and try again
You may die or get trapped in this game, nothing prevents you from restarting at any moment and getting back in an instant.

title: Sentry City
tagline: A Cyberpunk-style side-scroller

blocks.text: Sentry City is a cyberpunk-style side-scroller with gameplay that is part trial-and-error, and part reaction time based. Traverse the city using the motorcycle overworld map, blast and think your way through the levels, and fight tough bosses to uncover who is behind the city’s AI disruption.

Sentry City is a cyberpunk-style side-scroller with gameplay that is part trial-and-error, and part reaction time based shooter. Each level, and each section of each level is uniquely designed and not repetitive. It would sit at home with classic 8-bit/16-bit games, while also at the same time having it’s own original mechanics and feel. Traverse the city using the motorcycle overworld map, blast and think your way through the levels, destroy the AI brain in each sector, fight tough robot bosses to uncover who is behind the city’s AI disruption.
Features:

items: Blast and think your way through challenging levels and tough bosses in Sentry City’s cyberpunk-esque setting
Unique side-scroller game-play that is part trial-and-error, part reaction time based, and part puzzle. Each section and level is uniquely designed and not repetitive.
Super responsive controls for tight gameplay
Infinite lives and multiple checkpoints on every level
Runs at 60fps+ framerate
Hand-drawn pixel art graphics and animations including intro and outro cutscenes.
Modern lighting and effects to add style and feel
Time Attack for each level that rates you based on how fast you beat each level (for the speed-runners out there)
Beautiful Retro Synth-wave/electronic soundtrack

reviews.quote: Sentry City has its moments, and I think a certain kind of player might get really into it.

title: Laraan
tagline: Enter an old space of computer entertainment

blocks.text: Laraan is a Science-Fiction game about exploration in a desolate world. Created with a minimalist low poly style. Accompanied by a splendid movie soundtrack. You’re about to enter an old world of computer entertainment. Laraan bridges the gap between Cinema and Action/Adventure games with a completely old style of fluid, cinematic storytelling. Laraan is experienced best when using a controller, a Windows or Xbox game pad is ideal. Using a completely old graphic system of cinematic zooms, pans, close-ups, and cuts, Laraan gets you involved in a breathtaking story of inter-dimensional travel. You’ll duck as lasers saber, boulder crash, and monsters roar. The complete musical score and realistic, digitized sound effects will make you feel like you’re on a movie sound stage.
Features:

items: Great music and visuals
An interactive journey of a world to explore
Abstract and simple design
Level & obstacle variety
